market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$100. $120 settle requires a 20% rally in ~2 months. Plausible given active US-Iran tensions and Brent already at $111, but fairly demanding without further escalation. My probability is below the market's 0.49.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran tensions trajectory and any near-term supply outage
